mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 5.0% over the prior month indicates tightening labor market conditions that boost corporate profit margins, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods with UNRATE < 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic expansion that increases corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods with both PAYEMS and INDPRO rising, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%), higher discount rates compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in residential construction permits (HOUST) over the prior 6 months indicates strong housing market activity that supports consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods with rising HOUST, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When residential construction permits (HOUST) exceed 1000.0 (thousand units), it signals a robust housing sector that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods with HOUST > 1000.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicate active monetary policy response to inflation, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods with both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rising, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.0%), labor market slack suppresses wage growth and corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods with UNRATE > 6.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
